correctness.rationale: The reversible condition has a two-point-or-less antipodal normal form; each tensor piece covers one antipodal class and the occupied classes themselves are valid pieces. Independent class choices give the size-width polynomial. Both local bounds follow via one point per coordinate fiber per class and pigeonhole; equality iff one per class and every coordinate balanced. The d=2 threshold, parity witness for all d≥3, and minimum size four are established explicitly. The packaged checker directly exhausts dimensions two and three and samples the all-d construction through eight; these finite checks do not stand in for the general proof.

value.rationale: This is a uniform exact classification of a natural resource invariant—the least number of reversible-dependence parts needed to cover an arbitrary Boolean relation—together with the complete joint size/width enumerator and a sharp two-variable versus three-variable local-capacity transition. It distinguishes expressive tensor resources from simple projection-fiber bounds; the factor-two extremizers are characterized structurally. These results go beyond one-off finite values or a textbook restatement of functional dependence.
